research.title: They Are Billions — Build Your Colony
research.finding: Developer describes collection-radius cells, production increasing with covered trees, placement yield preview, non-overlapping collection radii and inexhaustible resource sources.

research.title: AoE IV — Update 9.1.109
research.finding: Woodline tree blockers persist until fully harvested; Mediterranean and Gobi Desert biomes also have dense forests.

research.title: AoE IV — Introduction to Generated Maps
research.finding: Layout parameters distribute resources, players and physical geometry; biome selection is separate from layout.

research.title: AoE IV — Mastering the Scenario Tree
research.finding: Ground tiles, grass, forest metadata, impassable maps and water tools are separate authoring layers.

research.title: Poly Haven — Fir Tree 01
research.finding: CC0 conifer candidate has LODs; full source about 8M triangles, not a directly usable RTS budget.

research.title: Unity Asset Store — Palm Tree Pack Free
research.finding: Listed free under Standard Unity Asset Store EULA; Built-in compatibility listed for 2021.3.30f1, not yet verified for project Unity 6000.6.1f1. Species, model budget and license redistribution limits require import review.

proposal.resource_forests: Approved tree meshes share one forest-cell definition with wood productivity, construction exclusion and NavMesh routing blockers. Keep visually recognisable wooded patches and traversable corridors.
proposal.decoration: Low grass, shrubs and clearly unreachable background vegetation have no economic cells; do not disguise reachable full-sized woodland as unharvestable decoration.
proposal.economy: Reuse current provisional per-effective-cell wood income. Keep existing renewable throughput behavior unless user chooses finite harvesting later.
proposal.performance: Reuse meshes/materials with instancing, suitable LOD and chunk culling. Forest blocking is based on logical patches, not one actively carving NavMesh obstacle or Update script per tree.
proposal.source_pipeline: Approved new models must first be recorded in ZombieGame_Environment.blend, then handed to Unity; no procedural replacement trees.

existing_asset_audit.tree_notes: One species, two LODs. Official tags burkea africana/wild syringa. Not a verified European oak or regional North African tree.
existing_asset_audit.showcase: Model instances render only; no resource economy or navigation blocking. Winter and Desert tree densities are currently zero.
existing_asset_audit.production_wood_rules: Provisional: footprint 4x4, collection radius 7, 10 wood/min per effective forest cell before resource tier modifiers.
existing_asset_audit.imported_demo: Current authored coastal demo hides wood recipe; needs approved lumber-camp model and approved resource-forest integration.
